drivers.explanation: Active patients fell about 35% in 90 days, from 6,703 to 4,390, and only 58.5% of forecast is being met, so the program is shrinking well below what was contracted.
Weekly portal users dropped from 19 to 12 (down 36.8%), and refill adherence is 70.4%, indicating weak engagement from the brand team and patients.
